title: Horaa Esports Finishes Eighth at PUBG Mobile World Cup 2026, Takes Home Nearly Rs 2 Crore
description:
Kathmandu. Nepali esports team Horaa Esports has finished eighth in the PUBG Mobile World Cup (PMWC) 2026, earning a total prize of $127,500, equivalent to more than Rs 19.4 million.

Horaa secured eighth place after competing in all 18 matches of the Grand Finals and finishing with 109 points. The team earned $57,500 from the group stage and an additional $70,000 from its Grand Finals performance.
